rules.title: Cloud Storage bucket is publicly accessible
rules.description: The bucket grants access to allUsers or allAuthenticatedUsers.
rules.remediation: Enable public access prevention on the bucket.

rules.title: Cloud Storage bucket lacks uniform bucket-level access
Cloud SQL instance is publicly accessible
rules.description: The instance has a public IP open to the internet.
rules.remediation: Remove public IPs and authorized networks 0.0.0.0/0.

rules.title: Cloud SQL instance does not require SSL
rules.description: SSL/TLS is not required for connections.

rules.title: Firewall allows 0.0.0.0/0 to SSH (22)
rules.description: An ingress firewall rule open to the internet covers SSH (22).
rules.remediation: Restrict source ranges or use IAP TCP forwarding.

rules.title: Firewall allows 0.0.0.0/0 to RDP (3389)
rules.description: An ingress firewall rule open to the internet covers RDP (3389).
rules.remediation: Restrict source ranges or use IAP TCP forwarding.

rules.title: IAM binding grants roles/owner
rules.description: A principal holds the primitive Owner role.
